question: What does an Alpha Vantage free key receive on its 26th request of a day: the HTTP status, the JSON field and text, and the instant the count resets (midnight UTC or midnight US Eastern)?
why: Third-party pages report HTTP 200 with an Information field and disagree on the reset instant; no Alpha Vantage page states either. Observing it needs a free key, which is behind a sign-up.
